224: In 2035, where robots are commonplace and abide by the three laws of robotics, a technophobic cop investigates an apparent suicide. Suspecting that a robot may be responsible for the death, his investigation leads him to believe that humanity may be in danger.

The extraordinary life story of Ray Charles.

No one comes close to James Bond, 007.

One man's dangerous attempts to clear his father's name

It all comes down to who's by your side.

Return to magic. Return to hope. Return to Narnia.

The incredible attack on Pearl Harbor.

THE SPIRIT... so willing! THE FLESH... so weak! THE ROMANCE... so wonderful!

One giant leap into the unknown.

What you can't see, can kill you.

Just when you thought it was safe to go back to the movies.

A lot can happen in 30 minutes.

Guess who's going to be the life of the party?

4832: A Hollywood songwriter goes through a mid-life crisis and becomes infatuated with a sexy blonde newlywed.
A temptingly tasteful comedy for adults who can count.

Ready or not, here they come.

The Heartbeat Story of Circus People, Filmed with the Cooperation of Ringling Bros. - Barnum and Bailey Circus!

Todd just lost his job. Now he has to find his life.

No parents. No counselors. No rules!

Nothing can cure the soul but the senses. — Oscar Wilde

Revenge is best served ice cold.

Thou shalt not covet thy neighbor's wife.

Unfortunately, they're both on our side.

Wherever life takes you, let love guide you.

All he wanted was an autograph.

Everybody agrees MGM's The Search is a wonderful motion picture!

We all leave this Earth the way we came.

What Embarrassment When We Discover..."WE'RE NOT MARRIED!"

If he's innocent, the truth could save him. If he's guilty, the lies could kill her.

23008: A young man tries to revive his parents' wilting marriage by traveling to the 1970s when their romance was budding to help make it bloom: something more complex than he expects.
23264: Vera is a famous TV personality who wakes up with Nikita in bed after a hard day of partying. The next day, when she wakes up, the same thing happens.

He will bring out the Devil in you.

Witness the brutal truth of the most controversial events.

Some legends are more than myths.

Together they have one hour to save their families from the wrath of bigwig.
25056: When India's top cricketer is kidnapped in the Middle East, a loose cannon and a rookie cop are tasked with finding him before the high-stakes match with Pakistan.

Who will succeed as the leader and become the CM?

26336: An incompetent gang of criminals attempt to go straight.
26592: A transgender woman, Haddi, moves to Delhi to join a gang of transpeople and cross-dressers headed by an influential man. But is this move aspirational or driven by revenge?
26848: After moving from their home to an apartment building, a new terror awaits Rini’s family.
27104: Mike, a rough sleeper in London, is trapped in a cycle of self-destruction as he attempts to turn his life around. Along the way, he encounters unexpected chances for a fresh start.
You're going to be just fine.

The future belongs to those who fight.
27616: A courier for a local crime lord must deliver a mysterious package while being chased by a horde of unusual gangsters.
27872: A peace-loving, part-time sheriff in the small town of Firecreek must take a stand when a gang of vicious outlaws takes over his town.
JAMES STEWART -- HENRY FONDA MEET IN THE HEAT OF FIRECREEK

28640: On the Wirral in the grim early years of Margaret Thatcher's premiership, the opportunities for thrill seeking young men looking to escape 9 to 5 drudgery are what they've always been: sex, drugs, rock n' roll, fashion, football and fighting.
28896: Set in Cold War in 1961, follows the story of diplomat and economist Dag Hammarskjöld, who boards a plane in a desperate attempt to negotiate a ceasefire from his enemies after he leads UN troops into their first wartime operation.
The Swede who challenged world politics.
29152: Hilmi Tok is a billionaire businessman. He dies one day while driving his own car. His real estate assets goes his son Bayram.
29408: The four old friends meet on the grave of the fifth of them, Perozzi, who died at the end of the first episode. The doors do not open, the control panel does not respond: the van has become an armored box and he is trapped like a mouse.

30688: A boy deals with the loss of his mother by creating a relationship with a dangerous monster.

There are things that can't be forget.
31456: In 1993, spectators at the last screening of a horror film at a downtown cinema fall one by one into the hands of a sadistic and ruthless killer.
No talking. No texting. No breathing.
31712: A group of college students gets entangled in the scheme of a fledgling caste outfit that wants to turn into a political party.

It's time to feed the baby.

If at first you don't succeed...

As she gets closer to the truth, she is forced to decide what kind of future she wants for herself.

34784: The legendary Tomas Milian stars as Cuchillo, a knife-throwing thief on the run from murderous bandits, sadistic American agents, his hot-blooded fiancée and a sheriff turned bounty hunter, all of whom are gunning for a hidden fortune in gold that could finance the Mexican Revolution.
